The main takeaway from our work is that
the AML1-ETO fusion protein and the K-ras G12D mutation cooperate to induce leukemia in mice.
the K-ras mutation alone is not sufficient for the initiation of leukemia, but rather it cooperates with other oncogenic mutations, such as AML1/ETS.
the AML1-ETO fusion protein is not a potent oncogene by itself, but rather cooperates with other mutations, including RAS mutations, to induce leukemia.
